title: South Korea has cleared 382 AI medical devices since 2023, yet not one adverse-event report has been filed
source_used: Yonhap News Agency (yna.co.kr, AMP page of a Korean-language wire story by reporter Shin Seon-mi, Seoul); fulltext fetched by the main session
key_facts: Yonhap (Seoul, 12 Oct 2026, 08:05 Korean time) reports that no adverse event (a harmful incident or side effect) involving an AI-based or digital medical device was reported in South Korea from 2023 to June 2026, while adverse events for new-technology medical devices as a whole rose each year.

The figures come from data that Rep. Heo Jong-sik of the Democratic Party of Korea, a member of the National Assembly's Health and Welfare Committee, received from the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.

Approvals, certifications and notifications of AI-based software medical devices were 62 in 2023, 108 in 2024 and 157 in 2025 (2.5 times the 2023 level), with 55 more in the first quarter of 2026; these four figures add up to 382, the total in the curator's headline, which Yonhap's text does not print.

Over the same period 27 adverse events were reported for new-technology medical devices, a category that includes in-vitro diagnostic devices: 1 in 2023, 8 in 2024, 16 in 2025 and 2 up to June 2026; none of them involved AI or digital devices.

Heo said that reporting is a legal obligation, so more than three years with not one report for AI medical devices could be a sign that the reporting system meant to catch software errors is not working.
Heo called for the criteria to be revised so that risks specific to software can be reported as adverse events, and for checks on whether hospitals and companies actually report.
Yonhap says AI medical devices are used to help read images such as CT and MRI scans and to assist disease diagnosis.
quote_evidence: 그러나 2023년부터 올해 6월까지 보고된 국내 AI 의료기기·디지털 의료기기 관련 이상사례는 '0건'이다.
연도별로는 2023년 62건에서 2024년 108건, 지난해 157건으로 2년 새 2.5배로 늘었고 올해 1분기에도 55건이 추가됐다.
허 의원은 이와 관련해 "(이상사례) 보고가 법적 의무인데도 AI 의료기기의 경우 3년 넘게 한 건도 없다는 것은 소프트웨어 오류를 잡아낼 보고 체계가 작동하지 않는다는 신호일 수 있다"고 지적했다.
why_it_matters_hint: AI scan-reading and diagnosis software is being cleared in growing numbers, but the system meant to catch its faults has recorded nothing, which a lawmaker says may mean the reporting is not working.
event_date: Figures reported on 12 Oct 2026 (Seoul time, 11 Oct 23:05 UTC); adverse-event data run from 2023 to June 2026 and approvals to the first quarter of 2026.
notes: Read in full in Korean from the main session's fulltext copy (a short wire story, 927 characters) and translated by the writer; the quotes above are the Korean originals. The 382 total is the sum of the four yearly figures (62+108+157+55), not a number Yonhap prints, and 'approvals, certifications and notifications' are three kinds of regulatory step, so 'cleared' in the pool headline is loose. 'Last year' is 2025 and 'this year' is 2026. No response from the ministry is reported in the text. Only Yonhap was read; no second outlet was searched. Event is inside the window, so the pool score of 6 is kept.
